AMP-AD1.0 MSBB QC

Jessica Lundin and ADTR Science Team

September 03, 2026

Definitions

Abbreviations: FP = frontal pole, IFG = inferior frontal gyrus, PG = parahippocampal gyrus, PC = prefrontal cortex, STG = superior temporal gyrus

To compare analysis results across studies (cross-cohort analysis) we chose to determine AD case/control status according to neuropathological data because cohorts had variable clinical and neuropathologic diagnostic information regarding AD case status.

AD diagnosis: Braak stage ≥ IV and CERAD measure equal to moderate/probable AD or frequent/definite AD.

Control diagnosis: Braak stage ≤ III and CERAD measure equal to none/no AD or sparse/possible AD.

Any donors who did not fall under diagnosis or control criteria were assigned as “other”.

RIN

Samples were marked as QC failures if RIN was NA (n=0)

Samples were flagged as QC warning if RIN < 2.5 (n=15) - no samples were belwo 2.0 (already filtered)

RIN is a numerical value that indicates RNA integrity.

Inferred sex

Examine average expression of key Y-chromosome genes to infer the sex of each sample. Genes used are RPS4Y1, EIF1AY, DDX3Y, and KDM5D, which were determined to be robust markers for sex in Staedtler, et al (2013).

Samples whose inferred sex did not match their reported sex were marked as QC failures (for now).

Reported sex vs inferred sex mismatches: 2 sample(s) from 2 individuals across all brain tissue regions (n=1259 total samples).

Validation for FastQC

Examine Phred score and average base content at each position of a read.

Samples fail QC if the Phred score is < 20.

Samples get a QC warning if the Phred score is below Q1 - 1.5 * IQR.

Samples get a QC warning if the base content is above Q3 + 1.5 * IQR for any base.

Samples with 2 or more warnings across all QC metrics fail QC.

Validation for MultiQC

Examined percentage of reads mapped and percentage of reads duplicated.

Samples were marked as QC failure if < 70% reads mapped or > 80% duplicated reads.

Samples were flagged as QC warning if reads mapped reported less than Q1 - 1.5 * IQR or duplicate reads reported more than Q3 + 3 * IQR. QC warnings were evaluated independently for each brain region (tissue type).
